run_main_visualize_objects: run the main function to visualize 3D object meshes from a dataset directory using Viser
run_add_selectable_mesh: run add_selectable_mesh to place a trimesh mesh at a given x,y position in the Viser server
run_trimesh_load_mesh: run trimesh.load to load an OBJ mesh file and force it as a single mesh
run_viser_add_mesh_trimesh: run server.add_mesh_trimesh to render a trimesh Trimesh object in the Viser 3D viewer
run_texture_to_color_conversion: run mesh.visual.to_color to convert TextureVisuals to ColorVisuals for Viser compatibility
